visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black-framed glasses, wearing a maroon t-shirt and a khaki cap backwards, sits at a light-colored wooden table in a brightly lit sushi restaurant. He smiles broadly while looking towards someone off-camera, with a plate of four salmon roe gunkan maki sushi in the foreground. (2) The camera pans down to a gray tiled floor. A person in black trousers and black shoes walks past in the background. A hand enters the frame from the left, holding a bright orange, bubbly-textured cardboard cutout that resembles a cluster of salmon roe. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the salmon roe cutout held by a hand. The surface is glossy and printed with realistic images of translucent orange spheres. The background shows blurred restaurant elements like stacked plates and a conveyor belt. (4) Returning to the man, he holds the thin cardboard strip and flips it over to reveal its plain white underside, looking amused yet skeptical. He unfolds the paper, showing it is just a flat headband rather than a 3D accessory. (5) The man places the orange cardboard headband on his head. A small square graphic advertisement pops up in the center of the screen, showing a man and woman wearing very voluminous, 3D-looking sushi-themed headgear, creating a reality vs. expectation comparison. (6) He adjusts the headband and looks toward a person off-camera. A female figure's arm and denim shorts are briefly visible in the side of the frame as he gestures. He continues to smile, seemingly laughing at the flimsy nature of the promotional item. (7) The man uses black chopsticks to pick up a piece of sushi. He wears the salmon roe headband while eating, looking directly at the camera with a playful expression. The background remains the consistent, clean interior of the restaurant. (8) The final shot shows the salmon roe cutout held up against the background of the restaurant's sushi conveyor belt. Various colorful plates of sushi move past on the belt under warm, even lighting.
